title.narrative: Improving Financial Accountability in the Private Sector in Cambodia

description.narrative: Objective of the IDF: to help the country implement international accounting and auditing standards and practices for private enterprises over time,thereby improving financial accountability and transparency in this sector; and to strengthen the accounting profession and improve the formation of professional accountants & independent auditors. To assist the recipient in the implementation of international accounting and auditing standards and practices for the private sector, and in the strengtheing of the accounting profession through the ofrmation of professional accountants and indpendent auditors. The grant has tow main objectives: (i) to help implement international accounting and auditing standards and practices for the private sector over time so as to improve financial accountability and transparency; (ii) to strengthen the accounting profession and improve the formation of professional accountants and independent auditors. Specific activities of the grant are: a) Developing a training strategy and training programs to implement the Accounting Law, accounting an dauditing standards b) Implementing a plan to strengthen capacity of KICPA and the NAX c) developing a certification process for CPA examinations and a train the trainer program for Accounting Technicians and CPAs d) Implementing training on prudent financial management and best practices for accountants and auditors e) carrying out an audit of the grant.
